Retro Floral + Caramel Clogs

A warm, playful take on casual fall dressing: retro florals up top, cropped bootcut denim through the leg, then rich cognac accessories to ground it. The chunky clogs give the outfit its 1970s character while the structured bag and belt keep it polished.
FallMild WinterSpringEveryday CasualWeekend OutingCoffee Date

What to Buy First

  1. Floral sweater — It defines the entire retro color story.
  2. Cropped bootcut jeans — The silhouette makes the clogs look intentional instead of bulky.
  3. Cognac clogs — They are the strongest style cue after the sweater.
  4. Brown bag — It repeats the warm leather tone and finishes the outfit.
  5. Belt — Helpful polish, but easy to substitute with one you already own.

Styling Tip

Keep every leather accessory in the same warm family—camel, cognac, or medium brown—but do not chase a perfect match. Slight variation makes the outfit look collected rather than overly coordinated.
